name: NotForProfitOrganisationUseOnly
summary: The card component of Not-for-Profit Organisation Use Only (DUO_0000045). It reads LegalDesignationCredential, compares them with its policy data, and outputs the DownloadGrantCredential that Grant download takes.

nonprofitLegalForms.description: ISO 20275 ELF codes the data owner treats as not-for-profit; a LegalDesignationCredential qualifies if its hasLegalForm is in this list. If the key is missing, nothing qualifies and access is denied.
